title: Raise vitest timeout on play graceful-close EOF test
description: packages/cli/test/cli.test.ts:208 'play graceful close on stdin EOF' spawns the built CLI via execFileSync and exercises the full graceful close pipeline including a Dolt .checkpoints write. Wall time is 4–7 seconds on healthy CI runners and ~6.3s locally on Windows. The test does not pass an it() timeout, so vitest's 5000ms default times it out on slow runners — observed under PR #57's CI where the same test passed at 4367ms in one job and failed at the 5000ms timeout in another. Root cause: missing explicit timeout. Fix: pass a generous timeout (e.g. 30_000ms, matching the inner execFileSync timeout) to the it() call.
notes: PR #58 opened (https://github.com/jbongaarts/loreweaver/pull/58). Added 30_000ms timeout to it() in cli.test.ts:208, matching the inner execFileSync timeout. Targeted run: test now finishes at ~6231ms and passes under the new ceiling; would have aborted at old 5000ms default. Full suite green.
close_reason: Merged via PR #58 (squash e9b0d48..66fb61e on main). it() now carries a 30_000ms timeout matching the inner execFileSync timeout, so the EOF graceful-close test stops flaking against vitest's 5000ms default on slow CI runners.
